title: Fixed price vs. time and materials: which contract fits your software project?

points.heading: How the two models work
points.body: On paper, fixed price puts the risk on the supplier and T&M puts it on you.

points.heading: The hidden cost of fixed price
points.body: No supplier prices a fixed-price project at their expected effort.

points.heading: The hidden cost of time and materials
points.body: T&M has the opposite failure mode: nothing forces convergence.
